## The claim

P4-23: chloroquine and the other D2 stress drugs are more potent in high-aneuploidy cell lines than in low-aneuploidy ones

**Prediction if true.** across PRISM lines split by published aneuploidy score, chloroquine shows greater potency in the high-aneuploidy group (one-sided rank test p < 0.05), and most D2 drugs point the same way

**What would refute it.** chloroquine shows no aneuploidy trend at p < 0.2, or the high-aneuploidy group is less sensitive
